name: platelet derived growth factor subunit B
pathways: positive regulation of MAP kinase activity

function.text: PDGFB encodes platelet-derived growth factor subunit B. Annotated molecular activities include chemoattractant activity and growth factor activity. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to basal ganglia calcification, idiopathic, 5 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include COL1A1::PDGFB fusion-associated uterine sarcoma; Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, fibrosarcomatous. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
